title: Post 2 | The Yellow Hours 🚪
style_prompt: liminal empty office space, yellow wallpaper, damp beige carpet, buzzing fluorescent ceiling lights, one bright light source, well exposed, 35mm film grain, no people, no faces, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 2:58 a.m. I counted the doors again.

scenes.narration: At 2:58 a.m. I counted the doors again.

shots.prompt: long empty office hallway at night, nine plain doors, one extra beige door glowing under a buzzing ceiling light

scenes.narration: Ten. Eleven. Twelve. A new door every time I looked away. So I stopped looking away.

shots.prompt: endless empty hallway with yellow wallpaper and damp beige carpet, long row of fluorescent lights, no people, no windows

scenes.narration: I tried to leave. The stairwell door was gone. I shouted for help. The hallway swallowed it. Only yellow walls. Lights humming. The carpet still wet.

shots.prompt: long yellow corridor fading into darkness at the end, lights flickering, wet carpet, empty

scenes.narration: I pressed my ear to the nearest door. Footsteps inside. Slow. Pushing a cart. The wheel squeaked, exactly like mine.

shots.prompt: plain beige office door with a small blank brass plate, cold fluorescent light, no numbers, no digits, no text

scenes.narration: I counted my steps. Then I heard them count back. Always one behind.

shots.prompt: yellow corridor corner with the edge of a cleaning cart and a mop bucket just visible, damp floor, buzzing lights

scenes.narration: Then a new sound. Pen scratching. Behind the wall. Writing the same sentence again and again.

shots.prompt: close view of a buzzing fluorescent ceiling tube above a plain beige door, dust in the air, no numbers, no text

scenes.narration: At the end of the hall was door thirteen. A paper note taped to it. My handwriting. It said, do not open this one.

shots.prompt: a plain beige door in a yellow hallway with a blank brass plate, a wet mop leaning on the wall, no numbers, no digits, no text

scenes.narration: I turned the paper over. Same pen. Same hand. On the back it said, you already did.

shots.prompt: a plain beige door in a yellow hallway with a blank brass plate, a wet mop leaning on the wall, no numbers, no digits, no text

scenes.narration: Behind me, the wheels started rolling again. Slowly. Toward me. And the cart was not empty.

shots.prompt: cleaning cart wheel leaving wet tracks on yellow carpet in an empty corridor

scenes.narration: So tell me. Do you open thirteen, or go back to ten?

shots.prompt: long empty office hallway at night, nine plain doors, one extra beige door glowing under a buzzing ceiling light
